comments.text:
CLI main.rs is ~900 lines mixing command dispatch, MIDI helpers, hex parsers, and SVD operations. Split into:
- main.rs: clap command definitions and dispatch only
- commands/: one module per command (ping, monitor, dump, svd_list, svd_import, svd_export)
- helpers.rs: shared MIDI connection helpers, hex parsing
- Remove parse_hex_address/parse_hex_size duplication via a generic helper

AUDIT: 'we should split that file, and keep only the high-level command definitions here'

title: refactor(cli): split main.rs into command modules and shared helpers
